plain: A man named Richard, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels about a former nuclear missile guard who says he was taken by aliens, says he once wrote to Bob Lazar, a well-known figure in UFO circles, about what happened to him. He stresses that he is not in this for anything, meaning he is not after money or fame.
